The first Santa token on the Robinhood Blockchain — the OG and the original first mover.

$SANTAHOOD is the native token of SANTRO EXCHANGE, the first centralized exchange on Robinhood Chain.

Built by the community, fueled by conviction, and driven by a long-term vision, SantaHood is expanding beyond the meme with Santro Exchange.

$SANTAHOOD serves as the governance token of the Santro ecosystem, with platform fees powering buybacks and burns.

“Santa would love Robinhood.” And now, Santa is building on Robinhood.
Launch coins on Pons paired with any asset, from memes to tokenized stocks.
The bridge out of X Money. Cash out to crypto, send crypto in, no KYC.
Tokenised price exposure to the defining private companies in the world. Vorta is being built now on Robinhood Chain, and early access opens to a small first group.

$NLYRA — Neron & Lyra, the two AI guardians of Robinhood Chain. The first AI scanner on this chain (69,000+ audits across 25+ chains): we read the contracts nobody else reads. We built the full stack — Architect Launch (anti-rug launchpad, liquidity locked for life, rugs impossible by design), Architect Swap (Uniswap V2+V3 with a smart router), single-sided staking, fixed-APY pools, zk privacy pools, and the Burn Engine that buys back and burns NLYRA forever. Fixed 1B supply. No owner, no mint, no taxes, no blacklist. On Robin Hood's chain, we stop the thieves.
